svg.text: One Transit Gateway links Hub/Dev/Stg/OnPrem VPCs; Resolver DELEGATE rules hand child-zone resolution to per-VPC Inbound Delegation endpoints
Resolver endpoints subnet · SG: 53/tcp+udp from VPC CIDR
single route table — all 4 VPCs attached
forwards system.example.com only — no per-child conditional forwarders
